author: KEXP
description: Wrexham-based four-piece The Royston Club devise a brand of dreamy indie rock favoring melodic guitar lines and anthemic choruses. With host DJ John Richards, the band share songs off their latest release 'Songs For The Spine,' including the track "Cariad."
title: The Royston Club performs "Cariad" & more Live on KEXP
